result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both pages pair a serif display face with a sans for body text, use a warm clay and sage palette, and give each element a clearly different weight. A has more personality: its serif feels more deliberate, the italic clay ampersand and green 'Fern' stand out, and the left-aligned layout with soft blurred shapes feels more modern. B's centered Georgia-style headline is clean but closer to the default look, though its card body text is a bit easier to read than A's light, small gray text. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages pair a system serif display face with a system sans for reading, use the same warm palette and follow the same card structure. B's type has more character (a refined old-style serif plus a geometric sans like Avenir), and its left-aligned, asymmetric layout feels more modern than A's centered Georgia-and-Helvetica layout, which looks more like a template. B's light-gray card body text is a little thinner and harder to read than A's, but B is still the stronger overall design.
